title: Naturality of the source-open comparison with restriction units
statement: Let f:X\to S, f':X'\to S', g:S'\to S and g':X'\to X be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with g'\mathbin{;}f=f'\mathbin{;}g, where semicolon means composition in diagram order. Choose unbounded derived categories for every scheme [def-pc-derived-category], objects K\in D(X), K'\in D(X') and a morphism \varphi:L_{g'}K\to K'. Let U\subset X be any open, t:U\to X its immersion, p:X'\times_X U\to X' and v:X'\times_X U\to U the canonical projections. Write L_s=derivedPullback(s), R_s=schemeDerivedDirectImage(s), and a_s:L_s\dashv R_s for the adjunction selected in [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] using the counits selected in [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Let c(s,r):L_r\mathbin{;}L_s\cong L_{s\mathbin{;}r} be the composition isomorphisms selected by that same theorem. Let k:R_{t\mathbin{;}f}\cong R_t\mathbin{;}R_f and k':R_{p\mathbin{;}f'}\cong R_p\mathbin{;}R_{f'} be the right-adjoint mates of c(t,f) and c(p,f') under a_{t;f}, a_f.comp(a_t) and a_{p;f'}, a_{f'}.comp(a_p), respectively. Define A=L_g(R_f(\eta_t(K))\mathbin{;}k^{-1}_{L_tK}) and B=R_{f'}(\eta_p(K'))\mathbin{;}(k')^{-1}_{L_pK'}. Then A\mathbin{;}b_U=b_K\mathbin{;}R_{f'}(\varphi)\mathbin{;}B, where b_U is the explicit source-open comparison of [def-pc-single-complex-open-comparison] and b_K is the canonical base-change map of [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. This is an equality of morphisms from L_gR_fK to R_{p;f'}L_pK', with no cartesian hypothesis on the original square or invertibility hypothesis.

proof.text: Transpose both sides under the composite derived adjunction. Expand the counit formula for the base-change map and use naturality and associativity of the canonical derived pullback composition comparisons; the pullback equation identifies the middle transports. Triangle identities cancel the open restriction unit and the remaining expression is the original base-change composite followed by the coefficient map.

theorem singleComplexOpenComparison_unit_naturality
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') (U : X.Opens) :
    let c := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))
    let a := fun {A B : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) ↦
      Classical.choose (exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction s
        (hAdd := (Classical.choose exists_derivedPullbackComposition) s)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)) s)
        ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
          (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition))) s))
    let p := pullback.fst g' U.ι
    let k := conjugateIsoEquiv (a (U.ι ≫ f)) ((a f).comp (a U.ι)) (c U.ι f)
    let k' := conjugateIsoEquiv (a (p ≫ f')) ((a f').comp (a p)) (c p f')
    (derivedPullback g).map
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).map ((a U.ι).unit.app K) ≫
          k.inv.app ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj K)) ≫
      singleComplexOpenComparison f f' g g' h K K' φ U =
    (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' h K ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map φ) ≫
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map ((a p).unit.app K') ≫
        k'.inv.app ((derivedPullback p).obj K'))
